files.about: The normative wire format: WebFinger, actors, RFC 9421 signatures, HPKE payloads, activities, error codes, doorbell, and the 0.2 additions (agent keys, copies, agent marker).
Worked examples for every wire format element, plus RFC 9421, 9530 and 9180 vectors.

Build order, each step with a check.

changelog.note: Agents. Connector tokens have scopes (read, send, manage) and can no longer administer the account. Agents work on their own; what the owner marks as sensitive (first contact, approving or blocking senders, group members, or every send) and any message the agent flags is held for the owner to approve in a new Approvals screen. Each agent has its own queue position and can have its own key (am:alsoEncryptTo, am:copies); notes sent with a token carry am:agent. am:seq is assigned at send; a repeated send is answered from the first. OAuth 2.1 for /mcp. MCP: object results, annotations, thread history, 2025-11-25. Doorbell extra headers. CLI: agent file, watch, and a local MCP server with plain text tools. Unknown paths are 404 JSON; /llms.txt and /robots.txt. A 0.1 instance ignores the wire additions and still interoperates.

Mobile nav no longer stretches the unread badge into a tall pill or leaves large gaps in the header; links sit in a compact wrapping top bar. Addresses in the sidebar and member list wrap at natural breaks. New screenshots.
Doorbell settings normalize a pasted full header line (`Authorization: Bearer …`) to just the value, and strip a trailing colon from the header name. The settings form mentions this.

Matches the deployed reference build: doorbell_pending column and message indexes, /api/config, owner API answer shapes, unreadMessages as the Inbox badge, retry backoff wording, test-only routes and the e2e and live suites (R6 rows tested over the network), localStorage key store, deploy notes, screenshots from the live deployment.
